body: brainstorm subcommand prompts gpt2-serve with the current registry as a seed list, parses candidate tags (tested against real captured completions). --tag <style> on add forces a specific style, creating+persisting it via Vertex AI (expandNamedStyle) if new, filling the rest via the existing dedup selection. Live-verified: 'add princess 4 --tag gladiator' created gladiator, forced it, filled 3 more, and it was reused for a second subject moments later. Also restarted a stuck gpt2-serve process found along the way (wedged since Aug 13). Commits b2a6fd1, b8c0a84, 94b5f59.
title: Prompt-o-verse: GPT-2 brainstorm tool + --tag forced-style flag
